content.title: What is the release date for Invincible season 4 episode 7 on Prime Video?
content.text: Invincible 4's second-to-last episode will air later this week (Image credit: Prime Video) Invincible season 4 is close to completing its current run on Prime Video. Indeed, there are only two more episodes to enjoy before the adult animated show goes on another year-long hiatus until its already announced fifth season arrives.So, when will this season's second-to-last episode make its debut on Amazon's streaming platform? Read on to find out when you'll be able to watch it.What is the launch time for Invincible season 4 episode 7?Invincible's next episode, which is titled 'Don't Do Anything Rash', will take flight on Wednesday, April 15. That's the same day that The Boys season 5 episode 3 will come out on Prime Video, so fans of R-rated comic-book adaptations will have plenty of new content to look forward to.Article continues below Latest Videos From TechRadarBut, I digress. Here are the exact times that Invincible season 4 episode 7 will drop on one of the world's best streaming services in various nations:US — Wednesday, April 15 at 12am PT / 3am ETCanada — Wednesday, April 15 at 12am PT / 3am ETUK — Wednesday, April 15 at 8am GMTIndia — Wednesday, April 15 at 12:30pm ISTSingapore — Wednesday, April 15 at 3pm SGTAustralia — Wednesday, April 15 at 5pm AEDTNew Zealand — Wednesday, April 15 at 7pm NZDTWhen will the final episode of Invincible season 4 come out?This season's finale is due to air on Prime Video a week after its predecessor. If that isn't clear, it means Invincible season 4 episode 8 will be released worldwide on Wednesday, April 22.Okay, there's always a chance that Amazon could move up its launch date. The e-commerce giant's entertainment division ended up releasing the final chapter of Fallout season 2 earlier than expected, so it could do likewise with Invincible 4's final installment. I'd be surprised if Prime Video did that, though, so I fully expect this program's latest finale to air on the aforementioned date.Follow TechRadar on Google News and add us as a preferred source to get our expert news, reviews, and opinion in your feeds.
